description: Mark Linux Windows dependency manager manifest. Maps Wine/Proton runtimes and DirectX requirements to upstream winetricks component names.

sets.notes: DirectX 9 content is translated through DXVK to the native Vulkan driver.
DirectX 11 content is translated through DXVK to the native Vulkan driver.
DirectX 12 content is translated through VKD3D-Proton to the native Vulkan driver.
